payload.title: Priming extraction failure hides the real reason code
payload.description:
Found by the Cyclotron session (read-only; refs at origin/main a35694b).

`src/papyrus_content/priming_curation.py:46` collapses any extraction failure, filter fallback or empty plan set into `ValueError("existing reference extraction did not complete")`. The real cause in `extraction["failures"][0]["reason"]["code"]` and its message are dropped, so operators cannot tell GROBID outages from bad URLs.

```gherkin
Feature: Priming extraction errors
  Scenario: Extraction reports a failure
    Given reference extraction returns failures[0].reason with code "grobid_unreachable" and a message
    When priming curation runs
    Then the raised error includes the code and the message
```
Acceptance: error text contains failures[0].reason.code and message; filterFallbacks and empty-plans cases each name their own cause; spec covers all three.
